fact: 1934年2月12日至15日奥地利内战爆发，估计死亡约350人。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Austrian Civil War
sources.quote: The Austrian Civil War of 12 to 15 February 1934... death toll estimated at 350.

sources.title: Haus der Geschichte OEsterreich, Dollfuss-Schuschnigg-Dictatorship
sources.quote: On each side, around 65 died, along with 120-140 unarmed persons. A great number of Social Democrats were arrested, and nine members of the Republican Defence League were executed.

fact: 1934年7月25日陶尔菲斯被党卫队冲入总理府枪杀，政变六日内逾200人死亡。

sources.title: Wikipedia, July Putsch
sources.quote: On 25 July 1934... Dollfuss was killed by two bullets... over 200 people being killed in six days of fighting.

sources.title: Federal Chancellery of Austria, The First Republic
sources.quote: On 25 July 1934, the Federal Chancellor Engelbert Dollfuss (1892-1934) was assassinated in the Federal Chancellery during an attempted coup by illegal National Socialists.

sources.title: Haus der Geschichte OEsterreich, July 1934 coup
sources.quote: On 25 July 1934, illegal Nazis disguised as Army soldiers ambushed the State Radio Broadcasting Station (RAVAG) and the Office of the Federal Chancellor... Despite the fact that the coup immediately failed, over 200 people were killed. The thirteen people involved in the coup were executed.

fact: 1934年5月1日残存国民议会将宪法改写为威权组合国家文件，废除直接议会选举，统治权落入陶尔菲斯手中，联邦国正式开始。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Federal State of Austria
sources.quote: The path to dictatorship was completed on 1 May 1934, when the Constitution of Austria was recast into a severely authoritarian and corporatist document... Direct parliamentary elections were abolished... all governing power was now in Dollfuss hands.

fact: 陶尔菲斯遇刺后墨索里尼向意奥边境调兵，希特勒宣布不支持政变；舒施尼格继任总理，祖国阵线执政至1938年德奥合并。

sources.title: Wikipedia, July Putsch
sources.quote: Mussolini moved troops to the Italian-Austrian border and told Hitler that he was not to invade Austria... Kurt Schuschnigg succeeded Dollfuss as Chancellor until the Anschluss in 1938.

fact: 二月起义失败后社会民主工人党与工会被取缔，1934年5月民主宪法被联邦国威权宪法取代，祖国阵线成为唯一合法政党。共产党1933年5月26日被禁，共和护卫团1933年5月31日被禁，奥地利纳粹党1933年6月19日被禁。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Austrian Civil War
sources.quote: The socialists defeat led to arrests, executions, and the banning of the Social Democratic Party. In May 1934, Austria democratic constitution was replaced by the authoritarian constitution of the Federal State of Austria, with the Fatherland Front as the only legal party.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Federal State of Austria
sources.quote: Dollfuss then banned the Communist Party on 26 May 1933, the Social Democratic Republikanischer Schutzbund on 30 May and the Austrian branch of the Nazi Party on 19 June.

fact: 据Gunther 1940年记载，1934年维也纳警察搜查106000处住宅，逮捕38141名纳粹分子、社会民主党人、自由派与共产党人；大部分被捕者很快获释，但1935年受审的护卫团成员被判处重刑。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Federal State of Austria (citing Gunther 1940)
sources.quote: in 1934 the police raided 106,000 homes in Vienna and made 38,141 arrests of Nazis, social democrats, liberals and communists... Most of those arrested promptly got out of jail again... although Schutzbunders tried in 1935 got mercilessly severe sentences.

fact: 德国1933年5月29日颁布、7月1日生效的千马克禁令规定德国公民赴奥地利旅行前须缴纳1000帝国马克费用（边境小额贸易除外），费用签注护照便于查验，意在打击依赖旅游业的奥地利经济。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Thousand-mark ban
sources.quote: The thousand-mark ban was an economic sanction imposed on Austria by the German Reich government on May 29, 1933, which came into effect on July 1, 1933. Henceforth, German citizens had to pay a fee of 1,000 Reichsmarks to the German Reich before any travel to or through Austria, except for small border traffic.

sources.title: Haus der Geschichte OEsterreich, Dollfuss-Schuschnigg-Dictatorship
sources.quote: Nazi Germany continued to pressure Austria, even economically, by imposing import embargos and a compulsory tax to discourage German tourists from visiting Austria.

fact: 先令1925年3月1日发行，1926年铸25先令金币（90%金）、1924年铸100先令金币（90%金）；1938年德奥合并时按1.50先令兑换1帝国马克被废除。1934年先令仍为奥地利法定货币，由奥地利国家银行发行。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Austrian schilling
sources.quote: The schilling was established by the Schilling Act of 20 December 1924 and issued on 1 March 1925. The schilling was abolished in the wake of Germany annexation of Austria in 1938, when it was exchanged at a rate of 1.50 schilling for one Reichsmark.

fact: 千马克禁令重创奥地利旅游业：1932年德国游客占奥地利旅游约40%；全国过夜人次从1932年1990万降至1933年1650万，1934年触底1590万；仅蒂罗尔一州过夜人次即从约440万跌至50万。旅馆、餐饮、缆车、导游等旅游相关行业在1934年处于收缩谷底。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Thousand-mark ban
sources.quote: The percentage of German tourists in Austria for tourism in 1932 was around 40%. The total number of overnight stays fell from 19.9 million in 1932 to 16.5 million the following year. The lowest was reached in 1934 with 15.9 million overnight stays. In Tyrol alone, overnight stays fell from 4.4 million to 500,000.

fact: 奥地利钢铁工业集中在施蒂利亚州尤登堡至莱奥本工业区；矿业以工业矿物、建筑骨料与钨等特种金属为主。大型钢铁厂、化工厂与石油公司雇佣数千人，但多数工商业企业按国际标准仍属小型。

sources.title: Wikipedia, July Putsch
sources.quote: There was fighting in Upper Styria, both the industrial area between Judenburg and Leoben and in Enns.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Economy of Austria
sources.quote: Several iron and steel works, chemical plants and oil corporations are large industrial enterprises employing thousands of people, most industrial and commercial enterprises in Austria are relatively small on an international scale. Austria mining industry focuses heavily on industrial minerals, construction aggregates, and specialized metals such as tungsten.

fact: 1934年二月内战估计350人死亡（其中约110名平民）、319人受伤，另有9人被处决；七月政变六日内逾200人死亡，事后多名参与政变的奥地利纳粹分子以叛国罪被处决或监禁。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Austrian Civil War
sources.quote: Estimated 110 civilians killed... 319 wounded... 9 executed... The overall death toll is estimated at 350.

sources.title: Wikipedia, July Putsch
sources.quote: over 200 people being killed in six days of fighting. A number of Austrian Nazis and collaborators were charged with treason and executed or imprisoned.

fact: 奥地利银行业呈三层结构：股份制银行、储蓄银行与合作银行；中央银行为奥地利国家银行。主要股份制银行包括Creditanstalt、Niederosterreichische Escompte-Gesellschaft、Anglo-Austrian Bank。1931年Creditanstalt危机后大型工业企业多被国有化。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Economy of Austria
sources.quote: The Austrian banking system is characterized by a three-tier structure, consisting of joint-stock banks, savings banks and cooperative banks. The central bank, Oesterreichische Nationalbank... many of its largest industry firms were nationalised.
